companyDescription: AI GPU · Blackwell/Rubin data-center accelerators + CUDA/NVLink ecosystem — the AI capex bellwether, now de-rated ~30% from its high on midterm regulation fears and a board probe of the CEO
priceNote: Live $168.89 on Nov 11, 2026, near the $164.27 52-week low (high $243.37). It is down ~24% in a month: the Nov 5 AI-chip selloff after the Democratic midterm sweep (data-center regulation fears), then -4% on Nov 9 when the board opened an independent investigation into Jensen Huang. Earnings are Nov 17 after the close.
summary: NVDA reports fiscal Q3 2027 on Nov 17 (company-confirmed, 5pm ET call). Guide is $108B ±2% at 74% GM, and consensus is ~$108.8B / EPS $2.47. The stock is back near its 52-week low after two non-fundamental hits: the Nov 5 midterm/AI-regulation selloff and the Nov 8 board probe of Huang. The board says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised, and Huang stays CEO. Consensus targets of ~$320–340 (Citi cut to $285, GS $300, Wells $300) leave ~+90% to consensus, far past the 20% gate. A clean beat-and-raise that re-anchors AI demand could plausibly retrace +20% of a -30% drawdown, which is why a mega-cap clears here. The catalyst is 6 days out, inside the 14-day North Star window. Core Base bias is +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a ~4–8 week post-earnings re-rating horizon, not a 14-day call. Size 5–8%; this is a de-rated core name, not a lottery ticket.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY2027 earnings — Blackwell/Rubin ramp + Q4 guide
catalysts.description: Company-confirmed for Nov 17, 2026 after the close (5pm ET call). Guide $108B ±2%, GM 74% ±50bp; consensus ~$108.8B / EPS $2.47. The Q4 guide and any read on 2027 capex vs. the regulation fears are the swing factors.

catalysts.name: Board independent investigation — CEO
catalysts.description: Opened Nov 8 by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel. No timeline. The board says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised, and Huang remains CEO.

risks: CEO investigation is an open-ended governance overhang. Any finding that forces a leadership change would hit the multiple regardless of earnings.
Data-center regulation risk under a Democratic Congress is a narrative that one earnings print cannot disprove.
Beat-and-fade history: NVDA fell ~6–7% after a clean beat in Aug 2024 because the guide missed the whisper.
Macro: a Dec 9 hike is ~89–100% priced, with a ~10% tail for 50bp. Long-duration tech is the most rate-sensitive group.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI semis are the epicenter of the Nov 5 selloff (SOX -9–12% on midterm data-center-regulation fears) and are rate-sensitive long-duration equities; a 50bp December surprise would extend the de-rating.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the hike is priced. Earnings on Nov 17 land before the Nov 25 PCE and Dec 9 FOMC, so the print is a clean test of fundamentals before the next macro hurdle.

entryStrategy.verdict: BUY (scale in) — the AI bellwether at its 52-week low into a dated print, with ~+90% to consensus. The overhangs are governance and politics, not demand. Measured core at-catalyst median is -6.9% (n=54; 74% of picks underwater at their event), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: NVDA usually runs into prints, but this time it is falling into one (-24% in a month). Positioning is washed out, which historically raises the odds of a relief move on any clean guide.

postWin.note: May 2023: NVDA +24% in a day on a guide of $11B vs $7.2B expected, then the largest market-cap jump on record. A de-rated setup makes a high-single to low-double-digit relief move the realistic base.

postLose.note: Aug 2024: NVDA fell ~6–7% after beating on revenue ($30.0B vs $29B) because the guide trailed the whisper and a Blackwell mask change spooked buyers.

spotSizing.reason: 6%. earnings_beat is not a Tier-2 laggard (laggard: partnership_win -1.6 vs +1.4 overall). The size is capped below a full core weight because of the open-ended CEO probe.

stopPreCatalyst.note: At -15%, wider than the core medianMAE (-14%). A break below ~$143 would mean the market is pricing more than sentiment, such as leadership change or a demand reset.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the Q4 guide comes in below consensus, cut on day 1. A beat with a weak guide repeats Aug 2024.

comparableCases.note: Upside template: a guide that resets the AI-demand narrative. The current setup needs a narrative reset too (regulation fears).

A mega-cap AI semi can move +20%+ in a day on a narrative-changing outlook. This is the self-check for mega-cap eligibility.
